correctness.rationale: The local coloring correspondence is bidirectional and restores the exact edge-subset definition. The six-state transfer matrix satisfies \(M^5=M^4+M^2\) by exact integer multiplication, and a fixed boundary matrix counts every tadpole coloring exactly. A four-case reversible leaf-extension bijection gives the t-recurrence; complete nine-case seeds are verified by independent brute-force edge-subset enumeration. Two strong inductions prove all \(c\ge3,\ t\ge1\) with no reliance on finite extrapolation. verify.py was run on the delivered candidate and all assertions passed.

Its general series-parallel counting algorithm does not imply the all-parameter extremal inequality without a new comparison argument. A September 2025 counting algorithm is confined to \(P_6\)-free graphs and misses unbounded tails. Exact and alias-oriented database/literature searches returned no covering theorem; closest identifiable records treat different invariants. value.rationale: Settles the cycle-maximal PED-count conjecture for all single-tail unicyclic graphs, an infinite two-parameter class beyond the proven tree case. The positive gap is determined exactly by two independent tribonacci-type recurrences and nine initial values, supplying strictness and quantitative structure. This is a motivated part of a stated contemporary open question, not an arbitrary enumeration or routine substitution. The general conjecture and branched/unicyclic extensions remain open.
